lessons.title: Non-Fiction: Easter Traditions
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to retrieve facts about Easter traditions from a non-fiction text.
success_criteria: I can find a fact about an Easter tradition.
I can answer a question using the text.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model reading a non-fiction text about Easter traditions.
lessons.independent_task: Children read an extract and answer retrieval questions.
key_questions: Where did you find that fact?

differentiation.greater_depth: Answer in full sentences using text evidence

lessons.assessment_notes: Note non-fiction retrieval skill — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.plenary: Recap facts found about Easter traditions.
lessons.home_link: Find a fact about an Easter tradition at home.

lessons.title: Fractions: Sharing Easter Eggs
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to find fractions of quantities using an Easter context.
success_criteria: I can find a half, quarter or third of eggs.
I can share fairly.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model finding fractions of Easter egg quantities.
lessons.independent_task: Children solve fraction problems using an Easter eggs context.
key_questions: What is a third of these eggs?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record fraction consolidation applied to a festive context — evidence for MATHS.N4.
lessons.home_link: Share treats fairly using fractions at home.

lessons.title: Easter Egg Pattern Design
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to create a repeating pattern design on an egg shape.
success_criteria: I can create a repeating pattern.
I can use colour purposefully.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at examples of patterned eggs from different cultures.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model designing a repeating pattern on an egg template.
lessons.independent_task: Children design and decorate their own patterned egg.

differentiation.support: Use a simple repeating pattern with adult support
differentiation.greater_depth: Create a complex original pattern design

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe pattern-making and colour choice — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.home_link: Decorate an egg shape at home if possible.

lessons.title: Writing About Spring and Easter
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write descriptive sentences about spring and Easter using expanded noun phrases.
success_criteria: I can use an expanded noun phrase.
I can write a sentence about spring or Easter.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap expanded noun phrases from earlier terms.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a descriptive sentence about spring/Easter using an expanded noun phrase.
key_questions: Can you use an expanded noun phrase?

differentiation.greater_depth: Write 4+ sentences with varied noun phrases

lessons.assessment_notes: Note grammar application in descriptive writing — evidence for ENG.W2/W3.
lessons.home_link: Describe spring or Easter to your family.

lessons.title: Easter Word Problems
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to solve mixed word problems using a festive context.
success_criteria: I can solve an addition problem.
I can solve a subtraction problem.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap addition and subtraction strategies to 100.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model solving word problems using an Easter egg hunt context.
lessons.independent_task: Children solve Easter-themed word problems within 100, showing working.
lessons.assessment_notes: Record word problem solving skill — evidence for MATHS.N2.
lessons.home_link: Make up an Easter word problem for your family.

lessons.title: Spring Flower Printing
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to create a printed pattern of spring flowers.
success_criteria: I can print a flower shape.
I can repeat it to make a pattern.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap printing techniques from earlier terms.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model printing flower shapes using stamps/sponges, creating a repeating pattern.
lessons.independent_task: Children create a printed spring flower pattern.
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe printing technique and pattern understanding — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.home_link: Create a print pattern using any safe household stamps.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Easter Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read Easter-themed words.
success_criteria: I can read Easter words.
I can read a sentence about Easter.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Reinforce a spelling pattern, applying it to Easter-themed words.
lessons.independent_task: Children read themed word and sentence cards.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics/spelling application — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading Easter words over the week.

lessons.title: Money: Easter Shopping
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to solve money problems involving totals and change using an Easter context.
success_criteria: I can find the total cost of items.
I can work out change.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model solving money problems using an Easter shopping context.
lessons.independent_task: Children solve money word problems involving buying Easter items, showing working.
lessons.assessment_notes: Record money problem-solving skill — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Practise working out cost and change with play money.

lessons.title: Studying Easter Art from Around the World
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe features of Easter-related art from different cultures.
success_criteria: I can describe what I notice.
I can compare two examples.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at examples of Easter/spring-themed art from different cultures.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss features of different cultural art styles related to spring celebrations.
lessons.independent_task: Children compare two examples of spring-themed art, recording observations.
key_questions: What do you notice about this artwork?
How does it compare to another?

differentiation.support: Point to and describe one feature
differentiation.greater_depth: Give a detailed comparison with opinion

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comparative art analysis and cultural awareness — evidence for ART.2.
lessons.home_link: Look at more cultural art examples together if possible.

lessons.title: Sharing Easter Traditions
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to share their own family traditions respectfully.
success_criteria: I can share a family tradition.
I can listen respectfully to others.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's learning about traditions.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss respecting and being interested in others' different traditions.
lessons.independent_task: Children share a family tradition (Easter or otherwise) with a small group.
key_questions: What tradition does your family have?
What did you learn about a friend's tradition?

differentiation.greater_depth: Share unprompted with confidence and detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language and respectful engagement with diversity — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.plenary: Recap the range of traditions shared.
lessons.home_link: Talk more about your family's traditions.

lessons.title: Symmetry in Easter Designs
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to create a symmetrical Easter-themed design.
success_criteria: I can create a symmetrical pattern.
I can explain how it's symmetrical.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model creating a symmetrical design using the fold-and-paint technique on an egg or butterfly shape.
lessons.independent_task: Children create their own symmetrical Easter-themed design.
key_questions: How did you make it symmetrical?

differentiation.greater_depth: Create a more detailed symmetrical design

lessons.assessment_notes: Note symmetry consolidation — evidence for MATHS.GEO.
lessons.home_link: Look for symmetry in nature or decorations at home.

lessons.title: Easter Class Display
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to contribute art to a collaborative Easter display.
success_criteria: I can add my art piece to the display.
I can talk about my contribution.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all art created this week.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss arranging individual pieces into a collaborative Easter/spring display.
lessons.independent_task: Children help arrange their art into a large collaborative display.
key_questions: What does it add to the display?

differentiation.greater_depth: Suggest arrangement ideas for the whole display

lessons.assessment_notes: Note collaborative and reflective art skills across the week — evidence for ART.1/ART.2.
lessons.plenary: Whole-class admiration of the finished display.
lessons.home_link: Describe the class display to your family.

lessons.title: Easter Traditions Quiz: Reading Comprehension
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer comprehension questions about Easter traditions.
success_criteria: I can answer a retrieval question.
I can answer an inference question.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a summary passage about Easter traditions, modelling retrieval and inference questions.
lessons.independent_task: Children answer a mix of retrieval and inference questions about the passage.
key_questions: Why might eggs be a symbol of spring?

differentiation.support: Answer retrieval questions with text pointing

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension progress — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on Easter traditions you learned.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Fractions, Money, Symmetry
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply fractions, money and symmetry skills learned this week.
success_criteria: I can find fractions of quantities.
I can solve money problems.
I can identify symmetry.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of fractions, money and symmetry.
lessons.independent_task: Children rotate through 3 stations covering each skill.
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise week 25 maths observations for each child — evidence for MATHS.N2/N4/MEA/GEO.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all three skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising fractions and money over the break.
